lines.text: [excited] Still running lead-acid? Same slot... totally different battery!
LiFePO4 weighs about a third as much.
And it lasts up to four times as many cycles.
Plus, you can use all of the capacity. The built-in BMS protects it.
Six to three hundred amp-hours, twelve or twenty-four volts. Series or parallel.
[excited] So what's still running on lead-acid at your place? Tell us in the comments!
